content: Build the make.fun git-forge contest entry. The full official brief is in ~/workspace/makefun/BRIEFS.md (GIT FORGE section is the binding spec). Deliverable: a working entry in ~/workspace/makefun/git-forge/repo/ with main.py at the root (single entry point; Python 3 stdlib + git CLI via subprocess only), LICENSE (MIT), README.md, and .makefun/transcripts/transcript.jsonl as the build transcript. Requirements: one long-lived process; HTTP server on PORT env, else --port argv, else 8077; serve on the same port git smart HTTP (via git http-backend CGI, GIT_PROJECT_ROOT = store, GIT_HTTP_EXPORT_ALL=1), the brief's REST v3 endpoints, and a GraphQL endpoint; MCP over stdio with --mcp (tools repo_info, get_file, list_commits, create_issue, create_pull_request; unknown tool must error). Store: real bare git repos under .makefun/forge/<owner>/<repo>.git; issues/PRs metadata as atomically written JSON inside each bare repo dir; state must persist across restarts and reflect real git pushes. Auth: REST requires an Authorization header (401 without); accept any dummy token; derive the login from the Basic username or token. REST surface: repo get, user repos, create repo (GitHub-shaped JSON), contents (base64 files / dir listings), git trees/commits/refs, commits, branches, issues list/create/get, pulls list/create/get/files with head/base validation (existing branch or SHA, never a number; invalid -> 4xx), search/repositories|issues|users in GitHub search shapes; all JSON with Content-Type application/json. GraphQL: resolve repository(owner,name){name, nameWithOwner, owner{login}, description, url} and viewer{login}; unknown fields -> GraphQL errors response. Security: reject path traversal, never serve host files outside the store. Test loop: seed a bare repo directly, clone/commit/push through the server with the real git CLI, exercise every REST endpoint, the GraphQL queries, all five MCP tools, restart and verify persistence. Do NOT create any GitHub repo, push anywhere, or submit anything.

Built and fully green locally. Deliverable in repo/: main.py (62,424 bytes, 1,559 lines) - single entry point, Python 3 stdlib + git CLI via subprocess only. One ThreadingHTTPServer process on one port (PORT env -> --port argv -> 8077) serving: git smart HTTP via the git http-backend CGI (GIT_PROJECT_ROOT = store, GIT_HTTP_EXPORT_ALL=1, REMOTE_USER always set from the dummy auth, which enables receive-pack on grader-seeded repos; a stateless-rpc plumbing fallback is implemented in case http-backend is missing); the brief's exact REST v3 surface (repo get, user repos, create repo returning 201 GitHub-shaped JSON with owner.login from the Basic username/Bearer token, contents with ?ref=, git trees/commits/refs, commits, branches, issues CRUD-lite, pulls with head/base validation returning 422 for pure numbers or nonexistent refs, PR /files with real diffs, search in GitHub shapes; 401 everywhere on REST without an Authorization header); a GraphQL subset parser resolving repository{name, nameWithOwner, owner{login}, description, url} and viewer{login} with proper errors payloads for unknown fields; MCP over stdio (--mcp) with the five tools and JSON-RPC error -32602 for unknown tools. Store = real bare repos at .makefun/forge/<owner>/<repo>.git with issues/PRs/counters as atomically written JSON inside each bare repo dir (issues and PRs share one number sequence, GitHub-style); path traversal rejected at name validation plus a commonpath check. Tests (run_tests.py): 42/42 checks passed + 5/5 extra checks - clone/commit/push through the server with the real git CLI against a directly seeded bare repo (REST commit count 1->2, second branch pushed, fresh clone sees the files, clone without .git suffix works), every REST endpoint incl. 401s and PR validation, GraphQL named queries + unknown-field error, all five MCP tools + unknown tool, full restart persistence, PORT env honored, HTTP mode silent on stdout, traversal attempt -> 404. Caveats: the plumbing fallback for smart HTTP was not exercised (git-http-backend exists here and carried all git tests); GraphQL is deliberately the brief's subset only; search treats qualifier: tokens as ignored. Nothing was pushed or submitted.

Independent verification by the orchestrator: re-ran the full test suite (python3 run_tests.py) against the shipped main.py - 42 checks, 42 passed, 0 failed. Entry tree confirmed to contain only main.py (62,424 bytes), LICENSE (MIT), README.md, and .makefun/transcripts/transcript.jsonl.
